q: There is no failure except in no longer trying. There is no defeat except from within, no insurmountable barrier except our own inherent weakness of purpose.
Courage is the price that life exacts for granting peace.
You must either modify your dreams or magnify your skills.
Sometimes you will never know the value of something, until it becomes a memory.
The world doesn't owe you anything. It was here first.
Do not regret the past. Look to the future.
A wise man makes his own decisions, but an ignorant man mindlessly follows the crowd.
Normal is the average of deviance.
Blessed is he who expects nothing, for he shall never be disappointed.
There is no fear for one whose mind is not filled with desires.
Originality is the fine art of remembering what you hear but forgetting where you heard it.
Even the smallest task is hard to accomplish without effort.
Truth is such a rare thing, it is delighted to tell it.
Magic is believing in yourself, if you can do that, you can make anything happen.
If you are unable to find the truth right where you are, where else do you expect to find it?
The clock indicates the moment...but what does eternity indicate?
To bear trials with a calm mind robs misfortune of its strength and burden.
Re-examine all that you have been told... dismiss that which insults your soul.
To succeed takes more than the desire to win. It also takes the acceptance that we could fail.
Be grateful for what you have now, and nothing should be taken for granted.
Simple words, repeated daily, can change your life.
Success is the sum of small efforts, repeated day in and day out.
Love your enemies, for they tell you your faults.
Life is to be fortified by many friendships. To love, and to be loved, is the greatest happiness of existence.
Never be bored, and you will never be boring.
Kind words can be short and easy to speak, but their echoes are truly endless.
The outer conditions of a person's life will always be found to reflect their inner beliefs.
Courage is the willingness to engage in a risk-taking behavior regardless of whether the consequences are unknown or possibly adverse.
Trying to predict the future is like trying to drive down a country road at night with no lights while looking out the back window.
It's your outlook on life that counts.
Your imagination is your preview of life's coming attractions.
Anger is an acid that can do more harm to the vessel in which it is stored than to anything on which it is poured.
Talk sense to a fool and he calls you foolish.
Love never keeps a man from pursuing his destiny.
The human mind defines things in relation to one another - without light the notion of darkness would be unintelligible.
The roots of education are bitter, but the fruit is sweet.
Nothing ever happened in the past that can prevent you from being present now; and if the past cannot prevent you from being present now, what power does it have?
Know yourself and you will win all battles.
We are like islands in the sea, separate on the surface but connected in the deep.
The saddest aspect of life is that there is no one on earth whose happiness is such that he won't sometimes wish he were dead rather than alive.
When you know what you want, and you want it bad enough, you will find a way to get it.
The key to success is to focus our conscious mind on things we desire not things we fear.
Courage is almost a contradiction in terms. It means a strong desire to live taking the form of a readiness to die.
Do your duty and a little more and the future will take care of itself.
He who can no longer pause to wonder and stand rapt in awe, is as good as dead; his eyes are closed.
Just do what must be done. This may not be happiness but it is greatness.
Those who seek the easy way do not seek the true way.
Success is like reaching an important birthday and finding you're exactly the same.
Be as simple as you can be; you will be astonished to see how uncomplicated and happy your life can become.
If you want to be happy, do not dwell in the past, do not worry about the future, focus on living fully in the present.
